_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.vi: Từ bẫy: library = thư viện, không phải librería (hiệu sách)
mistake.l1: Spanish “librería” means bookstore, so learners say library for a bookshop.

segments.text: Library, or bookstore? They are not the same place.
At a library, you borrow books for free.
At a bookstore, you pay for books.
Repeat after me. I study at the library.
Great job! Now you know the difference.

native.caption: Falso amigo: “library” es {m:library} y “bookstore” es {m:bookstore}. En la biblioteca pides libros prestados; en la librería los compras. Repite después de Ama y practica vocabulario en la app Lexkite.

en.caption: False friend: “library” means {m:library} and “bookstore” means {m:bookstore}. At the library you borrow books; at the bookstore you buy them. Repeat after Ama and practice vocabulary in the Lexkite app.
